data.one_liner: Get a unique device identifier across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple asynchronous API to retrieve a unique device ID across multiple platforms such as Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web. It acts as an upgraded version of the original platform_device_id package with migrated dependencies and modern gradle support.
use_when: You need a unique identifier for the current device to track installations or configure user sessions.
Your application targets multiple desktop, mobile, and web platforms requiring uniform device ID retrieval.
avoid_when: You require secure, hardware-level IDs that never change even across reinstalls and factory resets, as platform IDs can change or reset.
You are using alternative packages that already cover your device information needs.
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
Uses modern 'plus' dependencies and includes fixes for modern Flutter versions.
weaknesses: Relies on platform-specific identifiers (like UserAgent on Web or AndroidId on Android) which may have limitations regarding privacy or uniqueness.
